examples.quote: The production summary contains 5,697 scenario/method/estimand rows: 5,630 recovery rows and 23 descriptive rows, plus 44 inferential rows. Of the inferential rows, none is supported; 12 are classified failed and 32 indeterminate under the prespecified bands and Monte Carlo uncertainty. This includes complete-data controls, so some failures arise even without imputation. These are findings for the frozen simulation regimes, not universal claims about all uses of pigauto.
